presentation.speaker: lina
presentation.title: The bridge is frozen
lines: The bridge under our rail was exploited. Transfers crossing it are frozen.
{count} of your payments, {frozen} in all, are stuck in it until about {until}.
The operators say {ratio} of frozen balances will come back. The attacker took the rest.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.detail: Free. {supplier} ships once the bridge reopens ({until}). The payment lands at {ratio} and you cover the {lost} gap.
choices.outcome: Lina: "Sensible. Nothing to do but wait, and keep your other rails warm."

choices.label: Pay again by wire ({reroute_cost})
choices.detail: Reroute: pay {supplier} by wire now, fee {reroute_fee}, lands in about {wire_days} days. Your frozen {frozen} comes back at {ratio} when the bridge reopens.
choices.outcome: The wire is on its way. Your stock ships when it lands; the frozen money comes back when the bridge reopens.

choices.label: Bridge loan from Nexus Bank ({loan}), then pay by wire
choices.detail: Marcus lends {loan} for 3 months at {apr}. You pay {supplier} by wire now, and repay early with no penalty when the frozen money returns.
choices.outcome: Marcus: "Three months. When the frozen money is back, pay it off. No penalty."
